changes.title: Knockout respawn
items: Knocked out, your hat floats to the ground, then you scratch behind your decks until you can fly again: about six seconds in all, a little longer each time you are knocked down again soon after, a countdown over you, while your animals fight on without you

changes.title: Ravine shrine court
items: The ravine's spires, twin spires and stalagmites now all show, and stand round its legends' circles; its spires look like weathered rock, not stacked blocks
The stone shrine's pillars and tall cairns show at last, and its broken stones' pieces stand up beside them instead of lying flat like grey discs
Sports courts and pitches lie flat on the ground, without a raised edge

changes.title: Runestone carving
items: The sigils carved on the runestones are bigger and sharper, glow brighter, and have a faint lit rim, so you can make them out from across a clearing at night
